title: Machine learning highlights PBRM1, CA1 and TXLNG as pulmonary hypertension biomarkers
summary: Robust rank aggregation shortlisted 48 differentially expressed genes between Group I PAH patients and controls, and a gradient boosting decision tree chosen among seven algorithms gave a three-gene model (PBRM1, CA1, TXLNG) verified in an independent dataset. Upregulation of the three genes was confirmed in patient samples and a cell line model. AUC and cohort sizes are not given in the abstract.
ai_technology: Gradient boosting decision tree chosen among seven machine learning algorithms

evidence.tested: Independent dataset verification and experimental validation of expression in patient samples and a cell line.
evidence.unknown: Sample numbers, AUC and clinical utility are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Built the diagnostic model and selected the three biomarkers.
